caption: The drawing features a single translucent glass pitcher depicted in shades of greenish-blue. The pitcher has a curvaceous, bulbous body that tapers toward the top, with swirling, elongated patterns on its surface that mimic the appearance of blown glass. It has a wide spout and a sturdy handle which is attached at the top and bottom of the vessel, looping outward with a small decorative curl near its base. The base of the pitcher is fluted and rounded, adding stability and decorative detail. The composition is centered on a plain, beige background, with the artist's name, "Michael Trekur," written in the lower left corner. There is also a small, simple scale marker in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Pitcher
